name: Prophecy of the Ashened City
desc: Add 1 "Veidos" card from your Deck to your hand then if there is a card in the Field Zone, you can add 1 "Ashened" card from your Deck or GY to your hand and if you do, destroy a Field Spell on the field. If there is a Field Spell on the field, you can banish this card from your GY; Send 1 Pyro monster from your Deck to the GY then destroy 1 card on the field. You can only use each effect of "Prophecy of the Ashened City" once per turn.
strings: Add 1 "Veidos" card and apply Field Zone effect
Send 1 Pyro monster to GY and destroy 1 card
Add 1 "Ashened" card and destroy 1 Field Spell?
